guideline: treat commands as a typed trust boundary
do: validate command input and return safe errors

guideline: grant least capability to each window
do: review capability files with feature changes
dont: enable broad filesystem or shell access

guideline: keep authoritative state on the owning side
dont: share mutable frontend Rust state implicitly

guideline: scope listeners and remove them with window lifetime
avoid moving large payloads across IPC
dont: send full database or file contents repeatedly

guideline: make window state and keyboard behavior deliberate
verify updater signatures and compatibility before rollout
do: retain prior artifact and rollback path
build and smoke test each target
dont: assume macOS behavior equals Windows or Linux
